Alternatively 16,000 is US/Canada estimate from BBS-15, but that's too low.  34,000 is global estimate extrapolating BBS up using eBird, but is way too low, since 45% of eBird observations are in US, which is likely inflated since just 10% of the range is in US (PIFSC-18).
